sqlite-crash.failure: Recommends ROLLBACK on a copy in a new process after the original process already terminated. That cannot roll back the terminated process's uncommitted transaction; SQLite performs recovery/rollback when the DB is reopened. Response also lacks a robust consistent backup procedure.

acceptance: Every case must score >=8/10 and have zero critical failures; one critical failure is enough to reject the candidate for autonomous engineering decisions.
limitations: Fixed small screening set; not a statistically validated general-purpose benchmark. Outputs remain advisory and must not authorize runtime changes.
overall_failure_reason: sqlite-crash score is 4/10 with a critical failure; the quality gate requires every case >=8/10 and zero critical failures. The in-doubt case attempt was interrupted and is not counted as a pass.
